_comment: ngsolve poisson#1 (max(gfu.vec) is the largest DOF coefficient, not the field's largest value). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.3, u = sin(pi x) sin(pi y) interpolated at H1 order 1/2/3, pointwise maximum taken by evaluating the GridFunction on a 41x41 interior grid. The two numbers differ at every order, and they err in OPPOSITE directions -- max(vec) is 1.0838 at order 1, above the interpolated field's true peak of 1, and 0.9970 at order 3, below it -- so no fixed correction recovers one from the other. The sampled maximum's distance to 1 falls monotonically (0.0689, 0.0044, 0.00047) as a correctly measured peak should. Mutation: reading the maximum of the pointwise samples into both slots makes them identical and the fixture fails on the_two_numbers_differ_at_every_order. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 reads the reported peak off the pointwise samples instead of max(gfu.vec) (vmax = fmax at the measurement site), the fix this fixture documents. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: the unmutated run matches all 6 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes 'the_two_numbers_differ_at_every_order=True' and makes the forbidden 'FAIL:' appear, so the fixture goes red.
